what: The drum (drum.glb, three copies bent along the ride's path) scanned in the running game (?s3=round3): every vertex, in 0.25 m slices along the tunnel, measured in the path's own frame. The ride envelope is the space the mascot's body can occupy: up to 1.1 m either side of the middle (side lanes 0.7 m plus the 0.4 m body) and from 0.333 m below the still water line (a wave trough, minus the bob and the body's radius) to 1.88 m above it (the top of a jump plus the body's radius).
verdict: Traversable: nothing of the drum is inside the space the body can occupy in any lane, riding or jumping. The closest part is the drum's floor under the water, 3 cm below the lowest the body ever goes.
